import json

def load_and_summarize(path):

    return {
        'n': len(data),
        's1_mean': np.mean(s1) if s1 else None,
        's1_std': np.std(s1) if s1 else None,
        's2_mean': np.mean(s2) if s2 else None,
        's2_std': np.std(s2) if s2 else None,
        's4_mean': np.mean(s4) if s4 else None,
        's4_std': np.std(s4) if s4 else None,
    }

benchmarks = ['mmlu', 'gsm8k', 'arc_challenge']
regimes = {
    'Instruct (SFT+RL)': '/root/autodl-tmp/exp008/signals/rl_aligned/{bench}/signals_merged_{bench}.json',
    'd000 SFT (s42)': '/root/autodl-tmp/exp002/signals/Qwen2.5-0.5B_d000_s42/signals_merged_{bench}.json',
}

for bench in benchmarks:

    for regime, path_tmpl in regimes.items():
        path = path_tmpl.format(bench=bench)
